takes.intended_action: Steady rhythmic playing with a controlled head lift.

source_review.gate: Eligible for bounded motion generation; no animation/whole-cut approval
findings: Same adult blonde guitarist, long pale-blonde hair, dark eye makeup, black lace sleeves/corset/asymmetric skirt and dark strapped trousers. No narrative-redhead substitution.
Pendant is a neutral rounded petal/filigree ornament, not a cross. No other religious symbol introduced.

Same right-handed black cream-bound single-cut six-string guitar, two chrome humbucker pickups, four amber knobs and six tuning machines3+3; black strap over her LEFT shoulder supports the instrument.
Her LEFT hand remains at the fretboard with thumb/fingers plausibly wrapping it, RIGHT hand stays near bridge/pickups for picking/strumming. No implicit ownership flip or unsupported floating guitar.
Stage blue curtains/ornamental backdrop and amber/teal lighting remain in the same broad composition across each pair. Solo framing does not establish a changed band stage layout.

Full-body grounded stance is broadly stable; instrument and connected arms have compatible positions. Her head can naturally lift from focused downward attention toward the front while right hand continues a small strum.
The endpoints do not require a new body step, handoff or sudden instrument repositioning.
motion_conditions: Preserve same six-string hardware, two pickups/four knobs, strap endpoints, hand ownership, pendant and face/hair/costume through every frame.
Picking/strumming wrist must stay connected to her own forearm and act across/near the strings; fretting fingers remain causal, not melting into neck, fusing or gaining digits.
No stage sliding, guitar breathing/neck bending, autonomous knob/pickup movement, duplicated instruments or symbolic cross drift.

Head lift should be gradual and modest, without neck snapping, sudden smile, large repetitive nod or a forced full-body bob. Sustain coherent low-amplitude strumming rather than fast random finger flutter.
limits: Endpoint plausibility only, not a generated-motion pass, exact note/chord fingering or pick-to-note synchronization certificate.
Fine string paths/pick grip/finger overlaps at826x460 are limited; verify generated contacts densely and natural-speed actual-song insertion.
Do not animate a flat pose with camera movement alone or freeze the closing pose; natural supported breathing and small hand/cloth/hair continuation should remain.
